// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp6:e3m2).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = MATMUL_M / DIM / 2, tj = MATMUL_N / DIM / 2, tk = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t ab = 0;
    uint32_t bb = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tk * tj * DIM;
    int SDST = 128;

    // 1. Configure execution and MX formats (FP6 path)
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 1, 1, 3, 1);

    // 2. Load scale factors for both A and B
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);

    // 3. Load FP6 dequantization LUTs
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)B_lut_p, 1, 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)A_lut_p, 1, 1);

    // 4. Batched and Unrolled MVIN for Matrix A (cols = 32, step = 2)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < ti; i++) {
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 0 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 0) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 2 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 2) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 4 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 4) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 6 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 6) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 8 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 8) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 10 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 10) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 12 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 12) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + 14 * DIM), ab + (i * tk + 14) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
    }

    // 5. Batched and Unrolled MVIN for Matrix B (cols = 32, step = 2)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t) / 2);
    for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k * DIM * (MATMUL_N / 2) + 0 * DIM), bb + (k * tj + 0) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k * DIM * (MATMUL_N / 2) + 2 * DIM), bb + (k * tj + 2) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
    }

    // 6. Configure output and requantization with optimized granularity
    gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, tk);

    // 7. Perform Weight-Stationary compute via hardware fused loop
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

    // 8. Drain results to DRAM
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[0][0], SDST * 16, MATMUL_M * MATMUL_N);

    // 9. Fence to guarantee pipeline completion
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
